description: This file defines the SubscriptionDashboardController class, which manages user subscription views, cancellation, and related sidebar functionality within the dashboard module of a web application.

classes.name: SubscriptionDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user subscriptions, including viewing, cancelling, and sidebar menu creation within the dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, retrieves user, and initializes Stripe client.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Creates sidebar menu entries based on the current section and zone.

methods.name: getSubscriptionData
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a subscription and its associated product from Stripe.

methods.name: viewAction
methods.description: Handles displaying details of a specific subscription.

methods.name: cancelAction
methods.description: Handles the cancellation process of a subscription, including form handling and messaging.
